agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Decides which evidence classes the verdict still lacks and drafts their SQL (Nemotron via Nightshift; validator-gated)

agents.name: Retriever
agents.role: Runs read-only SQL against Zetaris (three sources, one schema) and records the access footprint

agents.name: Evaluator
agents.role: Applies the decision rules, finds conflicts and gaps, sends the Planner back for more evidence (max 3 rounds); then asks the model for an independent second opinion and escalates to a human on disagreement

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Proposer: drafts the summary and the report with per-claim citations, what could not be confirmed, next checks, redacted

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Scores the summary on a 0-3 x 3 rubric (accuracy, appropriateness, actionability); below 7/9 returns one fix and the Reporter revises once

agents.name: H-MEM (Meterless engine)
agents.role: Remembers findings with provenance across investigations; re-verification raises confidence, changes supersede

agents.name: World Model (Meterless engine)
agents.role: Shared entity graph: accounts, datasets, tickets, exceptions; dossier feeds the Planner and Evaluator
